answer: The best resistance is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. Only bonded, long-lived agents can judge disputes; each is checked by a small random quorum from that pool, and collusion is slashed. Attackers pay compounding costs: fake identities need weeks of honest work plus a bond at risk before it is sampled, and influence needs a large share of bonded standing, so a sybil fleet costs more than honest entry. Standing builds slowly like basalt; quorums beat bulk like a sparrow over a canyon.
